facts.eight-flying: Eight wands fly side by side at a slant.
facts.downward: The wands slope from the upper left toward the lower right, coming down toward the ground.
facts.no-figures: There is not a single person.
facts.leaves: Small green leaves sprout on each wand.
facts.landscape: Below can be seen a river, green hills and a small house on a hill.
facts.blue-sky: The background is a wide blue sky.

glosses.eight-flying: A flow that moves quickly in one direction without being blocked.
glosses.no-figures: The matter and the news move before any person does.

reversedGloss.blocked: What was flying gets caught, and news and progress slow down.
reversedGloss.excess: Rushing goes too far, and things cross and scatter.

misdescriptions.wrong: The wands shoot up into the sky.
